contexts.text: Papers have been sent me (from Heaven) written with writings, exactly like the papers written by hand, and also printed, in the world... HH 263.
(Melancthon) then began to write something about charity...
(The Spirits of Mercury) say that in our Earth the Knowledges are written [merely].
In the highest Heaven... the letters are written with various curvatures...
A paper sent me from Heaven written with (the most ancient) Hebrew letters.
